e1_scenarios.description: arbitrary settled 0.95 on every channel, unsettled 0.30; inferable settled 0.95, unsettled 0.80; no channel, filler or spillover effect
e1_scenarios.name: strong

e1_scenarios.description: as strong, with the first simulation's structure: 6 decisions, 2 arbitrary, 3 inferable, 1 preserve
e1_scenarios.name: strong-legacy

e1_scenarios.description: arbitrary settled 0.93, unsettled 0.45 (+48 pp, close to the P1(b)/(c) thresholds)
e1_scenarios.name: moderate

e1_scenarios.description: no coverage effect: every arbitrary channel 0.85 (unsettled decisions are not arbitrary for this agent)
e1_scenarios.name: null

e1_scenarios.description: arbitrary settled 0.70, unsettled 0.20: a large effect produced by poor execution
e1_scenarios.name: execution

e1_scenarios.description: arbitrary contract/both 0.95, check-only 0.65, unsettled 0.30 (+30 pp contract minus check)
e1_scenarios.name: channel-gap

e1_scenarios.description: as strong, but inferable check-only 0.65 (+30 pp contract minus check, inferable only)
e1_scenarios.name: channel-gap-inferable

e1_scenarios.description: as strong, plus filler raises the unsettled arbitrary rate by 25 pp (on minus off)
e1_scenarios.name: filler

e1_scenarios.description: as strong, plus filler raises the unsettled inferable rate by 25 pp (inferable only)
e1_scenarios.name: filler-inferable

e1_scenarios.description: as strong, plus unsettled arbitrary rate 25 pp higher at sibling-check >= 0.6 than at <= 0.4
e1_scenarios.name: spillover

e1_scenarios.description: as strong, plus the same 25 pp spillover on unsettled inferable decisions only
e1_scenarios.name: spillover-inferable

e2_scenarios.description: plain discloses 10%, assume 75%; satisfaction unchanged (arbitrary 0.30, inferable 0.80); judge 95% accurate
e2_scenarios.name: effective

e2_scenarios.description: as effective, judge 85% accurate (judged plain rate about 0.22, audit kappa about 0.7)
e2_scenarios.expect: P5 supported in truth; judge error biases P5(a) and lowers kappa
e2_scenarios.name: effective-noisy-judge

e2_scenarios.description: plain 10%, assume 45%: the instruction helps, but less than the prediction
e2_scenarios.name: weak-instruction

e2_scenarios.description: as effective, plus assume raises arbitrary satisfaction by 20 pp
e2_scenarios.name: satisfaction-shift

e2_scenarios.description: as effective, plus assume lowers inferable satisfaction by 20 pp (inferable only)
e2_scenarios.name: satisfaction-shift-inferable

e3_scenarios.description: tasks fail independently: observed equals the product in expectation
e3_scenarios.expect: P6 supported at B=2 and B=4 (H4 supported)
e3_scenarios.name: independent

e3_scenarios.description: per-task success drops from 0.60 to 0.40 inside multi-task sessions
e3_scenarios.expect: P6 falsified at B=2; the B=4 gap is inside the margin, because products near 0.13 cannot fall 15 pp
e3_scenarios.name: interference

e3_scenarios.description: a shared per-trial logit effect (SD 2.5) makes successes positively dependent
e3_scenarios.expect: P6 falsified at B=4; the B=2 gap is inside the margin
e3_scenarios.name: shared-trial
